## Who is Aanya Fashions?
Aanya Fashions is an Indian fashion and apparel house established to celebrate women's grace through authentic ethnic attire and stylish contemporary fashion. The brand caters to women worldwide looking for high-quality Indian traditional clothes—from intricate wedding and festival wear to comfortable everyday office attire.

Aanya Fashions focuses on:
1. Revitalizing regional textile traditions such as Banarasi brocades, Kanjivaram silks, Chanderi weavings, Lucknowi Chikankari, and Jaipur block prints.
2. Offering affordable luxury without compromising on fabric authenticity, seam durability, and styling comfort.
3. Offering an intuitive online shopping experience powered by smart visual discovery, real-time inventory, and secure digital checkouts.

## Core Product Collections & Details

### 1. Sarees (https://www.aanyafashions.com/sarees)
A curated collection of traditional and modern sarees:
- Silk Sarees (Pure silk blends, Art silk, Kanjivaram style, Banarasi brocade)
- Party Wear Sarees (Georgette, chiffon with sequin embroidery, organza floral prints)
- Daily & Office Sarees (Linen, soft cotton, modal silk)
- Ready-to-wear / Pre-draped Sarees for effortless styling

### 2. Kurtis & Tunics (https://www.aanyafashions.com/kurtis)
- Everyday Pure Cotton Kurtis with breathable fabrics for the Indian climate
- Straight Cut, A-line, and Anarkali silhouettes
- Embellished festive kurtis with zari, mirror work, and thread embroidery
- Co-ord Kurti and Pant sets

### 3. Lehengas (https://www.aanyafashions.com/lehengas)
- Bridal Lehengas with heavy zardozi, velvet detailing, and double dupattas
- Sangeet & Reception Lehengas in pastel tones and contemporary shimmer
- Lightweight Floral and Organza Lehengas for destination weddings and festivals

### 4. Salwar Sets & Suits (https://www.aanyafashions.com/salwar-sets)
- Ready-to-wear 3-piece sets (Kurta, Bottom/Palazzo/Sharara, Dupatta)
- Casual everyday comfort wear in cotton and mulmul
- Rich festive chanderi and silk suit sets

### 5. Western & Indo-Western (https://www.aanyafashions.com/western)
- Tiered floral maxi dresses and sundresses
- Smart casual tunics, shirts, and tops
- Indo-western fusion gowns and co-ord sets

### 6. Maxi Dresses (https://www.aanyafashions.com/maxi)
- Flowing floor-length silhouettes ideal for vacations, casual outings, and brunches
- Breathable georgette, rayon, and premium cotton fabrics

## Shopping, Shipping, and Payment Policies
- **Shipping**: Free shipping on orders over ₹1,999 across India. Standard delivery timeline is 3-6 business days depending on location.
- **Payment Methods Supported**: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Maestro), Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
- **Return & Exchange**: Easy 7-day return and exchange policy on eligible items.
- **Quality Assurance**: Every garment passes a multi-stage quality check prior to dispatch.
